cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.
